prompt: Use the provided crop as the approved visual reference and recreate it as a clean production asset at the target aspect ratio. This is a designed illustration plate. Output the same drawing, same style, same line weight and shading. Preserve silhouette, composition, perspective, palette (#f0f4f6, #082856, #2a6ac6), lighting, material, and texture exactly. Remove every piece of UI text, label, caption, button, and interface chrome that is not part of the artwork itself. Remove letterboxing, borders, card corners, drop shadows, and any layout background that the page will draw in code. Do not add objects. Do not change the concept. Do not restyle. The artwork fills the whole frame edge to edge at the same scale as the reference; no margins, no border, no background band. Region: small golden-brown Ddoski mascot peeking above the active role tabs with handwritten note.
postprocess: The generated plate ignored its own prompt in the same way the tower plate did: it returned a 2103x748 opaque RGB composite that baked in the interface chrome the page is supposed to draw — the blue hacker tab field, the cream judge tab field, the cool desk background, a scales icon duplicating the live lucide <Scale> icon, and the handwritten line 'Same you. More impact.'. Because the raster carried the judge tab's paper, the CSS had been forced to render that tab transparent with its icon hidden, and the plate's baked blue (#2169cf) did not match the tab's #2a6ac6, so it read on screen as a mismatched rectangle across the deck. Repaired deterministically with ImageMagick: cropped to the mascot (430x372+745+128), keyed the two flat backdrops with low-tolerance connected flood fills (5% fuzz, seeded only from the border so no holes were punched inside the artwork), closed the pinholes the fur highlights opened (-morphology Close Disk:7), removed the residual cream and cool-white scraps by colour distance, and trimmed to 394x282 RGBA. The judge tab now draws its own paper field, border, shadow and icon in CSS, and this plate contributes only the mascot. A small number of pale scraps remain in the plate's bottom-left corner; they sit behind the tab deck at every breakpoint. Re-render with a true transparent background to remove them. 2.1MB -> 184KB.
